svg.title: When family assets reach another generation
svg.desc: During a parent’s life: A gift may help a younger household afford a deposit.. After a death: A will can transfer property or savings to an heir.. Distribution: A family with few assets cannot provide the same advantage.

g.text: When family assets reach another generation
A gift may help a younger household afford a deposit.
A will can transfer property or savings to an heir.
A family with few assets cannot provide the same advantage.
